title: Require Provider Package Boundary
forbids: a resource provider without one public index, project metadata, and TypeScript boundary or with a non-TypeScript implementation face outside its test tree
why: A provider is one concrete realization of its parent resource contract. One public index preserves that boundary while wildcard TypeScript interiors admit honest vendor-specific client, lifecycle, declaration, and configuration decomposition.
remediate: Keep index.ts, project.json, and tsconfig.json as required provider faces. Permit the independently governed AGENTS.md router, colocated tests, and vendor-specific TypeScript implementation files; move resource contracts and product policy to their owning layers.
message: Every resource provider must retain one closed typed implementation package and public index.
